title.original: Portable Agent Memory: A Protocol for Cryptographically-Verified Memory Transfer Across Heterogeneous AI Agents
title.zh: 便携式代理内存：跨异构AI代理的加密验证内存传输协议
title.en: Portable Agent Memory: A Protocol for Cryptographically-Verified Memory Transfer Across Heterogeneous AI Agents

inclusion_reason.zh: Portable Agent Memory 定义带来源证明、能力授权和安全 rehydration 的跨供应商记忆互操作协议。
inclusion_reason.en: Portable Agent Memory defines a cross-vendor interoperability protocol with provenance proof, capability authorization, and safe rehydration.

abstract.zh: Portable Agent Memory 是跨异构 Agent 迁移持久状态的开放协议与参考实现。它定义五类记忆模型，以内容寻址条目和 Merkle-DAG 记录防篡改来源，并结合能力访问控制、抗提示注入的 rehydration 与 JSON/CBOR 序列化。
abstract.en: Portable Agent Memory is an open protocol and reference implementation for moving persistent state across heterogeneous agents. It defines five memory components, content-addressed entries linked by a tamper-evident Merkle-DAG, capability access control, injection-resistant rehydration, and JSON/CBOR serialization.

problem.zh: Agent 积累的事件、知识、技能、工作状态和偏好被锁在供应商运行时中，直接导出既缺少完整性证明，也可能把恶意记忆注入目标模型。
problem.en: Agents accumulate events, knowledge, skills, working state, and preferences inside vendor runtimes, while naive export lacks integrity proof and can inject malicious memory into a target model.

approach.zh: 协议按五类结构打包记忆，用哈希与 Merkle 来源图验证内容，能力令牌控制选择性披露，目标侧 rehydration 在适配模型时对间接注入进行隔离。
approach.en: The protocol packages five structured memory classes, verifies content through hashes and a Merkle provenance graph, scopes disclosure with capabilities, and sanitizes indirect injection during target-side rehydration.

system_design.zh: 导出器生成内容寻址包、Merkle-DAG 与能力范围，传输层使用 JSON 或紧凑 CBOR；导入器验证完整性和权限后，通过模型适配 rehydration 将安全内容注入新 Agent。
system_design.en: An exporter creates a content-addressed bundle, Merkle-DAG, and capability scope; transport uses JSON or compact CBOR; an importer verifies integrity and authority before model-adaptive rehydration.

key_results.zh: 参考实现含通过测试的 Python SDK 和多平台 Agent skill，并展示 GPT、Claude、Gemini 与 Llama 架构之间的跨模型记忆迁移。
key_results.en: The reference implementation includes a tested Python SDK and skills for multiple platforms and demonstrates memory transfer across GPT, Claude, Gemini, and Llama architectures.

limitations.zh: 密码学完整性不能证明记忆内容真实或安全，能力撤销和长期密钥管理也未在摘要中展开；不同模型对同一记忆的语义解释仍可能不一致。
limitations.en: Cryptographic integrity does not prove that memory content is true or safe, and capability revocation and long-term key management are not detailed; target models may still interpret identical memory differently.

metrics.name: transfer coverage
metrics.value: GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, and Llama architectures

notes.zh: 四个模型家族、跨模型迁移和 54 项 SDK 测试来自官方摘要；具体版本、迁移任务、攻击测试与硬件待全文审计。
notes.en: Four model families, cross-model transfer, and 54 SDK tests come from the official abstract; versions, transfer tasks, adversarial tests, and hardware await full-text audit.
